name: computer-managing-system
description: Authorized Windows server/device management MVP with a coordinator, visible agent, and Electron controller.

scripts.check: node --check apps/server/index.js && node --check apps/agent/index.js && node --check apps/controller/main.js && node --check apps/controller/renderer/renderer.js && node --check tests/integration.test.js && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$files=@('scripts/install-cms.ps1','scripts/run-controller.ps1','scripts/run-agent.ps1','scripts/dev-server.ps1','scripts/dev-agent.ps1'); foreach ($file in $files) { $tokens=$null; $errors=$null; [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile((Resolve-Path $file), [ref]$tokens, [ref]$errors) > $null; if ($errors.Count -gt 0) { $errors | ForEach-Object { Write-Error \"${file}: $($_.Message)\" }; exit 1 } }"
